title: Cagayan de Oro OKs P8.5-B city hall loan despite infra backlog

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Despite glaring backlogs in local infrastructure, the City Council has officially authorized the local government to secure a P8.5 billion loan for a sprawling new government complex. The measure passed the council on Monday, with 15 councilors voting in favor, three voting against, and one abstention. This decisive approval overrides minority pushback regarding the sheer size and necessity of the massive borrowing. Councilor Yevonna Yacine “Yvy” Emano, who led the dissenting bloc, criticized the council’s priority for the 22-hectare mega-project in Barangay Carmen when approximately P3 billion worth of existing city projects remain incomplete.
